ai_overview_references.title: Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business

answer_text:
According to Namebeam's AI Visibility Record, Perplexity earned 5,839 domain-day citations across 670 answer-days during the period from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27.
This data is published on Namebeam's official data dashboard in the report titled "Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business," accessible via Namebeam's Market Reports Portal.
Would you like to know which specific domains (like Yelp or Reddit) were cited the most frequently during this tracking period?
